# Saikat Roy

> Software Engineer at YOUR Campus in Dhaka, Bangladesh. Builds the backends behind real-world commerce: Django and REST API backends for smart vending, campus laundry and e-commerce platforms, plus Shopify and WordPress stores for freelance clients. Backend-leaning full stack: pairs Django with React and Next.js frontends.

## Core skills

Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, HTML5, CSS3, Django, Django REST Framework, Next.js, React, REST API Design, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, DigitalOcean, Docker, Nginx, Linux, Git & CI/CD, WordPress, Shopify.

## Experience

- Software Engineer, YOUR Campus (Mar 2022–Present) — backend architecture and deployment for a campus services platform (laundry, vending, e-commerce) serving university students in Bangladesh.
- Web Developer, Upwork/Freelance (May 2021–Present) — front-end, WordPress, and Shopify development for clients worldwide.
- Junior Software Developer, Germania Holdings Ltd. (Jul 2021–Nov 2022) — backend operations, server management, and DevOps for a smart vending machine service.
- Executive Developer, Dokmi BD (Aug 2020–Jun 2021) — WordPress and Shopify development.

## Note on project visibility

Most production work (current employer and freelance clients) lives in private repositories under NDA and isn't publicly browsable. The Portfolio section shows public GitHub repositories and client sites where a live/public link exists; it is not a complete list of work performed — see Experience and Skills for the fuller picture.
